board.name: Board Bored
board.tagline: The free local board. Events, open shops, and the people behind them. No apps, no ads, no cuts.

events.name: First Friday Art Walk
events.blurb: Art, coffee, vintage, music — the downtown shops stay open late. Walk in, say hi, keep it local.
events.logistics_note: Streets stay open all night — every vendor spot is on the sidewalk, not the road. Keep at least 4 feet of clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians and wheelchair users at all times — never block a curb ramp, crosswalk, or building entrance. Booth zone: Eye St from 18th (at the public garage) to West 21st St, both sidewalks, plus the 19th & Eye corner extending onto 19th St. Spacing is based on a real 6ft vendor table (9ft pitch) — full corridor could theoretically hold ~386 booths both sides; these 28 are a starter layout on the busiest 2 blocks, not the ceiling.

history.note: The first First Friday Art Walk under Board Bored — 5 downtown businesses, one live map, zero apps.
